energy.outlook: Eastern England is the UK's offshore wind capital. East Anglia FOUR (3.1GW, Vattenfall) DCO granted — major onshore construction programme starting. Sizewell C advancing with planning consent. National Grid SETR transmission reinforcement connecting offshore wind via Eastern corridor. UK Power Networks RIIO-ED2 Eastern £1.5bn active.

real-estate.outlook: Cambridge Biomedical Campus Phase 3 is Europe's largest science investment. Cambridge South station opening unlocking further development. Harlow Gilston Garden Town progressing. Stevenage and Peterborough regeneration active. East West Rail corridor driving growth at multiple stations.

maritime.outlook: Freeport East (Harwich and Felixstowe) active with tax site investment. Port of Felixstowe capacity enhancement progressing. Thurrock Thames Freeport operational. Haven Gateway ports seeing port infrastructure investment driven by post-Brexit freight patterns.

highways.outlook: A428 Black Cat to Caxton Gibbet dualling in active construction — key East West Rail enabler. A47 improvement programme delivering multiple schemes. A12 Chelmsford widening in procurement. East West Rail corridor driving road investment at Cambridge, Bedford, and Milton Keynes.

utilities.outlook: Anglian Water AMP8 £9.5bn programme in full delivery — largest in Anglian Water's history. Focus on storm overflow, water recycling, and supply resilience. National Grid ET HNDP offshore wind transmission reinforcement active. Sizewell C grid connection preparation underway.
